parts.name: Peltier TEC1-12706
parts.notes: Peltier A + Peltier B: 40 x 40 x 3.8 mm, 12 V, ~4.5 A each. Search: "TEC1-12706 Peltier 2 pack"

parts.name: Water block 40x80
parts.notes: Aluminium liquid cooling block 40 x 80 x 12 mm, 2 barbs. Search: "40x80mm aluminum water cooling block"

parts.name: Heatsink
parts.notes: Extruded aluminium heatsink ~150 x 80 x 30 mm, vertical fins. Search: "aluminum heatsink 150x80x30"; any 140-150 x 70-80 x 25-30 fits

parts.name: 12V brushless pump
parts.notes: Quiet inline brushless DC pump, 12 V ~0.4 A, 6 mm barbs. Search: "12V brushless mini water pump inline quiet"

parts.name: BTS7960 H-bridge
parts.notes: 43 A IBT-2 module with screw terminals; reverses the Peltiers for heat mode. Search: "BTS7960 43A motor driver"

parts.name: Nano screw-terminal board
parts.notes: Arduino Nano terminal adapter / expansion board with DC input. Search: "Nano screw terminal expansion board"

parts.name: D4184 MOSFET module
parts.notes: Pump MOSFET module + Fan MOSFET module. Search: "D4184 MOSFET module"

parts.name: 12 mm momentary panel button, pre-wired
parts.notes: Power, Cool/Heat, Eco/Max, Timer buttons. Search: "12mm momentary push button pre-wired"

parts.name: DS18B20 probe + adapter (water)
parts.notes: Waterproof probe with screw-terminal adapter (pull-up on board), through the tank lid grommet. Search: "DS18B20 waterproof probe adapter module"

parts.name: DS18B20 probe + adapter (heatsink)
parts.notes: Zip-tied to the heatsink base: over-temperature cut-out

parts.name: Mean Well GST220A12 12 V 15 A adapter
parts.notes: UL-listed sealed desktop adapter, 180 W, 4-pin DIN (R7B). Search: "Mean Well GST220A12-R7B"

parts.name: DIN power socket
parts.notes: KPJX-4S female 4-pin DIN panel socket, 16 mm hole, solder lugs. Search: "KPJX-4S 4 pin DIN power socket"

parts.name: Inline blade fuse holder (15 A)
parts.notes: 14-16 AWG holder with a 15 A ATC fuse

parts.name: Wago 221-415 (12 V)
parts.notes: 5-way lever connector, 12 V bus

parts.name: Wago 221-415 (GND)
parts.notes: 5-way lever connector, ground bus

parts.name: Hose bulkhead barb fitting
parts.notes: Hose bulkhead IN / OUT in the back panel + 2 in the tank: 1/4 in (6 mm) barb, nut + gasket, 12.5 mm hole. Search: "1/4 barb bulkhead fitting"

parts.name: Silicone tube 6 mm ID, 3 m
parts.notes: Insulated hose IN / OUT: 6 x 9 mm food-grade silicone, 2 x 1 m pad hoses (40 in like Flux) + internal runs; small hose clamps

parts.name: Foam pipe insulation 3/8 in
parts.notes: Slit foam sleeve over both pad hoses

parts.name: Water cooling pad
parts.notes: Water Cooling Mattress Topper Pad (Without Machine), 70 x 160 cm, 6 mm hose connections. Price estimated, not confirmed. Smaller than the Flux Twin pad (35 x 71 in)

parts.name: Thermal paste
parts.notes: Both faces of each Peltier

parts.name: Acrylic solvent cement (Weld-On 4) + applicator
parts.notes: Welds the 6 clear tank pieces

parts.name: Aquarium silicone sealant
parts.notes: Inside tank seams, fill-neck flange

parts.name: M3 nylon standoff kit
parts.notes: Mounts the BTS7960, Nano board, MOSFETs and pump on the bottom panel

parts.name: Dupont jumper kit + 18 AWG wire
parts.notes: Female-female jumpers for signals, red/black 18 AWG for power

parts.name: VHB double-sided tape
parts.notes: OLED behind the front-panel window

parts.notes: shown with a reference model
